info.prompt: A high-resolution digital painting of Farkle Frenzy's Gothic Cyberpunk game interface, featuring a skeletal gold filigree frame with intricate bone-like lattices surrounding a deep void black board where neon cyan and electric magenta dice tiles glow with internal bioluminescence, each face revealing translucent gem-like facets under hover, while a hacker-style terminal overlay at the bottom displays live system logs in glitchy green text, atmospheric vignette pulling focus to the center where wild tiles emit rainbow hue-shifting coronas amidst falling crystalline particle effects.
